_readme: talentsforever.com data export for the Druid. Fan-made WoW Forever talent calculator; talents, racials, Legacy perks and the class spellbooks come from the WoW Forever beta client's own data files (the site began as frame-by-frame reads of the BlizzCon 2026 demo), so numbers can lag live tuning. talents: per class, trees with talents (row/col are 1-based grid positions, max is the rank cap, desc maps rank number to tooltip text, confirmed lists ranks read verbatim, others are estimates; classic shows the Classic-era equivalent for comparison). spellbooks: per class, every trainer spell to level 60 with every rank (levels = the level each rank is learned at; checked = that class's city trainer was read in game, the rest are from the files only; the General tab dates from the demo reads). spell_desc: tooltip text keyed class|spell|rank, s=beta means the beta client's text at level 60 with no gear, s=demo means read off footage, s=classic means Wowhead Classic fallback, nt=1 or 2 means the class trainer does not sell that rank (1 portal trainer, 2 tome, quest or drop). racials and legacy: racial abilities and the Legacy perk trees. changelog: what changed on the site.
